hypothesis: M197 shows that tiny guarded PPO smoke from M194 is repeat-stable and both fresh seeds improve the fixed M193 objective while preserving behavior, protected key, old replay, and refreshed replay. A single short stage2 from the best fixed-loss retained repeat may continue the same improvement without washing out the proof surface.
success_criteria: start from runs/ppo_m197_guarded_from_m194_seed5197/checkpoint.pt because it is the lowest fixed-loss retained repeat
run only one short guarded stage2 before any repeat or longer continuation
keep M194 as the strong action anchor through configs/ppo_m196_guarded_from_m194_smoke.json
preserve old M183 M168/M170 replay gates and refreshed M193 M189 replay gate
compare fixed M193 objective against M189, M194, M196, and M197 before accepting any repeat
failure_criteria: run multiple stage2 seeds before the first stage2 gate passes
run a longer PPO continuation directly
drop any M183 or M193 replay row
promote based on fixed objective improvement alone
